description: This Java interface defines a client for interacting with Hono's Command and Control API, including methods for sending commands and one-way commands to devices, with support for response handling and message properties.

classes.name: CommandClient
classes.description: An interface for sending commands to devices within Hono's API, scoped to a specific tenant.

methods.name: sendCommand
methods.description: Sends a command to a device and expects a response, with optional content type and properties.

methods.name: sendOneWayCommand
methods.description: Sends a one-way command to a device without expecting a response, with optional content type and properties.
